gist: Sensei promised Koyuki he'd keep quiet to Yuuka about the broken game-room cabinet she hid; Yuuka brought it up knowing, because Sensei told her, and he shrugged it off when Koyuki confronted him.
transcript:
[{DAY} 00:00] What you remember of the last while

### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 07:50] Sensei!! Okay okay, hear me out. The arcade cabinet in the club room has a teeny tiny crack in the screen. Not my fault. Mostly.
[user:sensei 08:02] Koyuki...
[you 08:03] Yuuka will put it on my debt ledger and I'll be in the Self-Reflection Room until graduation! Please don't tell her. Pretty please.
[user:sensei 08:10] Fine. I won't say a word to Yuuka. Promise.
[you 08:11] That's a promise? Pinky promise?
[user:sensei 08:12] Pinky promise. Go to class.
[you 08:12] [face=happy] Nihahaha!! Best Sensei!
### chat:huddle:t2h6q8b1ka
# {DAY}
[momoi-saiba 10:40] [face=happy] Koyuki, game jam flyer! Prize is a controller skin and bragging rights.
[you 10:41] [face=happy] Bragging rights are the only currency I trust. I'm in!
[momoi-saiba] You should pick a team name first. Mine is Pixel Trio.
[you 10:42] How about White Rabbit Hole? Sensei can be mascot.
[momoi-saiba] He'd just ask about the budget.
[you 10:43] Boring! Next!
[noa-ushio 12:20] [face=content] The club room is open again. Cleaners finished the window.
[you 12:21] Perfect. Nobody needs to look at the cabinet. It's very, very fine. Absolutely.
[noa-ushio] I have not said anything about the cabinet.
[you 12:22] [face=nervous] Right. Nothing. Great talking.
[yuuka-hayase 14:05] Koyuki. Club room. Now.
[you 14:06] [face=nervous] Yuuka-senpai! Hi! Is it about the jam flyer? It's very legal.
[yuuka-hayase 14:07] It's about the cabinet screen. Sensei mentioned it this morning. He said you'd cracked it and it was an accident.
[you 14:08] [face=shocked] He... said that?
[yuuka-hayase] Replacement is forty-two hundred credits. It goes on your ledger with the others, unless you want to pay it at once.
[you 14:09] [face=flustered] This is a plot twist. Okay, okay, I'll... I'll be right back.
### chat:direct:user:sensei
# {DAY}
[you 14:15] Sensei. You PINKY promised.
[user:sensei 14:40] Oh, that. Yuuka asked me straight whether anything in the club room was broken, and I didn't want to lie to her.
[you 14:41] She asked? Or you said first? She said you MENTIONED it this morning!
[user:sensei 14:44] It came up. It's not a big deal, she'd have found out anyway. Better from me, right?
[you 14:45] Better for who?!
[user:sensei 14:47] Just pay it off in small parts. She's reasonable.
[you 14:48] [face=pouting] Boring answer. Next!
